text:
nora: Quick poll  do we put hydration mode into the pin metadata or handle via ops console?
alex: put it in metadata. Ops needs to reason about it per-rollout.
ben: +1. Suggest an enum: off | async_prefetch | client_probe.
tara: telemetry: make sure prefetch runs are annotated so we can exclude them from normal latency/cost curves.
javier: infra: async_prefetch needs rate limits and tenant quotas; prefetch failures must fail-open to lazy.
nora: agree. Action: add `hydration` enum to pin schema, telemetry keys rollout.hydration and rollout.hydration_attempts, admin status endpoint for hydration. I'll draft RFC update.
